'''''Vicia monantha''''', the '''barn vetch''', is a widespread species of annual herb in the family [[Fabaceae]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=''Vicia monantha'' (Barn Vetch) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/FABC/Vicia_monantha.php |access-date=2022-03-05 |website=www.maltawildplants.com }}</ref> It native to the Mediterranean region, and western and central Asia, and has been introduced to Australia.<ref name="POWO_524947-1" >{{cite POWO |id=524947-1 |title=''Vicia monantha'' Retz. |access-date=21 October 2023 }}</ref> Typical of vetches, it has a climbing habit and pinnate leaves.<ref>{{Cite web |title=''Vicia monantha'' Retz. |publisher=Encyclopedia of Life |url=https://eol.org/pages/703214 |access-date=2022-02-04 |website=eol.org }}</ref>
